name: Memory of Osoyo
description: The party's memories of Osoyo coalesce into a titanic mirage in the storm clouds above.
disable: DC 22 Occultism (trained) or DC 24 Arcana (trained) to divert the memory's rage; three total successful checks are required to disable the hazard
routine: (1 action) The memory of Osoyo gives a keening scream that shatters the layer of ice coating the deck of the Mermaid's Tears. Any creature on difficult terrain created by the memory's Glacial Gust takes (2d8+7) Cold Damage (Basic DC 26 Reflex Saving Throw) from the icy shrapnel.

generalAbilities.name: Glacial Gust
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger The characters' shared vision during Event 15 subsides

Effect The memory of Osoyo unleashes a tremendous sigh of freezing wind, coating the deck of the Mermaid's Tears in ice in a 60ft Cone. (The hazard can choose any point for the cone to originate.) The area becomes difficult terrain. Creatures in the area must succeed at a DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw save or take 1d6 Persistent,cold Damage as the freezing wind cuts to the bone. The hazard then rolls initiative.
